- Lyrics word by word, even syllable by syllable, when the song has them: LRCLIB's word-timed records ("hasWordSync") and NetEase as a second source (Settings > Lyrics > Extra source). Each word fills as it is sung; a song without word times follows its lines, then shows plain text. Lyrics kept beside a song with line times only get their words in the background (kept by the app; the song's file is not touched). The lyric info line says Word by word, Line by line or Plain text.
- A smaller app: the default APK is 64-bit only; the release has a separate 32-bit APK (Pulse-<version>-32bit.apk, lite) for old phones, and the updater picks the right one. 68 of the 74 bundled Winamp skins are now "More Winamp skins" in the Extra store (3 MB). Chinese, Japanese and Korean PDF character maps are left out (a PDF with those fonts shows no text from them in the book reader). The 209 launcher icons are WebP (0.65 MB less).
- Glass launcher icons: dark Material glass in the colours of the example, Pulse's own is a pulse in a ring.
- Downloads are offered where they are used: "More Winamp skins" in the Winamp skin picker, and, under the stock wallpapers of a look, the higher-quality versions of those same pictures: Windows 11 in 4K (3840 x 2400, 4.1 MB), Windows 10 and Windows 7 in 1920 x 1200 (1.3 and 2.2 MB). Installed, they take the place of the small pictures in Pulse's windows and the launcher. The Extra store lists them too. (XP's pictures are 800 x 600 at the source, so they stay as they are; the phone-shaped pictures have no larger source.)
- The lyrics already on the phone get their word times once by themselves, in the background, after this update (Settings > Lyrics: "Give the lyrics on the phone their word times", and "Add word times now").
- Battery and performance: the loops of the screen (clocks, polls, the monitor's readings, the launcher's badges and "At a Glance") now run only while the app is on the screen; before, they went on in the background every one to three seconds. The sampler reads every 4 seconds unless a live graph is open; widgets are redrawn every 15 seconds (every 2 minutes with the screen off); the monitor service sleeps while the screen is off; the Office Assistant and the Windows clocks wake less often. Game Hub: the selection halo no longer breathes for ever on Android.
- A smaller app, by downloads that come by themselves where they are used (Extra store): the icon packs of every look except Windows 11 (icons-<look>), the bird sounds, the gym (exercises, programs, foods, drawings), and the Windows 11 / 10 / 7 wallpapers in higher quality. The Office Assistant pictures (clippy, 0.9 MB) are downloaded only when the assistant is switched on.
- Gym: 111 exercises show a short loop of two real photos (start and end of the move) from the public-domain Free Exercise DB, in the exercise detail and the session; the drawn picture stays for the others.
